name: Jerod's Landing
summary: Defias smugglers hold Jerod's Landing beside the Nazferiti River in Elwynn Forest. Its dock gives them a hidden route for stolen goods across the kingdom's waterways.

sections.title: A Smuggler's Waypoint
sections.body: Defias outlaws control the dock at Jerod's Landing, where Elwynn Forest meets the Nazferiti River. Once an ordinary boat dock, it now receives goods plundered from the Redridge Mountains. A Defias dockmaster watches over the cargo as the outlaws move it downstream toward holdings such as Klaven's Tower in Westfall.

sections.title: Eyes in the Shadows
sections.body: SI:7, Stormwind's covert intelligence network, watches Defias activity at Jerod's Landing. The operatives see the dock as a vital link in the syndicate's supply lines. Resourceful rogues slip inside to steal river shipment ledgers and work to unravel the wider conspiracy strangling the kingdom.

faq.answer: Jerod's Landing lies in eastern Elwynn Forest, on the western bank of the Nazferiti River. The river marks the boundary between Elwynn and the Redridge Mountains.
Members of the Defias Brotherhood occupy Jerod's Landing. A Defias dockmaster coordinates shipments while armed bandits guard the waterside.

faq.q: What is the purpose of this dock for the Defias?
aliases: why do defias use jerods landing
faq.answer: The Brotherhood uses Jerod's Landing to smuggle stolen goods and weaponry taken in the Redridge Mountains toward rogue strongholds such as Klaven's Tower in Westfall.

faq.q: Why is SI:7 interested in Jerod's Landing?
faq.answer: Master Mathias Shaw and his intelligence agents track Defias contraband through Jerod's Landing. They seek to expose the network linking Westfall, Elwynn, and Redridge.

angles.text: As a rogue working for SI:7, you are sent to Jerod's Landing to test your stealth, pickpocket the Defias dockmaster, and recover sensitive trade ledgers.
As an Alliance member, you can see how thoroughly the Defias have compromised the waterways linking Elwynn to Redridge, right beneath Stormwind's nose.
